_source: What running Civitas costs that the site can't read for itself, for /environmental (app/environmental.py). The machine, the models' sizes and the pipelines' hours are read by the site (app/environmental.py, app/environmental_sampler.py), never typed here. What stays here is a dated measurement, a published figure or a labelled assumption, each with its source and date; everything worked out from them is computed in app/environmental.py. data_refresh alerts when EPA publishes an eGRID edition newer than `grid.edition`.
_contract: Each figure set has `source` (a short credit, shown under its box) and `date` (ISO, when measured or published). Add a figure here only if the site can't read it, with both.

boardPower.window: 05:01 to 05:22 UTC, while the Senate pipeline ran
boardPower._whyNotSampled: The Pi 5's power is read from its PMIC over the firmware mailbox (/dev/vcio, crw------- root:root on the host). No container is given it: the services run unprivileged with no devices (docker inspect, 2026-10-21: Privileged=false, Devices=[]), Swarm services can't be given a device, and the only hwmon sensors a container sees are cpu_thermal, nvme, rp1_adc, pwmfan and rpi_volt, none of them power. So this is one dated reading, and the whole-machine figure stays an assumption.

assumedWatts.source: Our assumption, set above the board's measured peak

llmUse._whyNotSampled: The llama.cpp server runs without --metrics (GET /metrics answers 501) and the Action Center keeps no count of its model calls, so this is one day's reading of the server's request log.
